title: Moldova and Romania plan to develop Prut River navigation with links to Ukraine
summary: Moldova has proposed working with Romania to develop river infrastructure and restore navigation on the Prut River, partly to strengthen transport links with Ukraine.

title: Officer suspected of torturing subordinates extradited from Mondova to Ukraine
summary: A Ukrainian serviceman suspected of ill-treating his subordinates has been extradited from Moldova to Ukraine.

title: German city of Darmstadt donates generators to schools and kindergartens in Uzhhorod
summary: A delegation from the German city of Darmstadt, led by Mayor Hanno Benz, has donated five high-capacity generators worth more than €116,000 to Uzhhorod to ensure uninterrupted operations at schools and kindergartens.

title: SSU arrests suspected Russian agent posing as volunteer to direct strikes on Kramatorsk
summary: Counterintelligence unit of the Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) has arrested a contract soldier who, according to investigators, had gone AWOL from his military unit and was helping Russian forces direct strikes on Kramatorsk in the Donetsk region.

title: Ukraine ready to accelerate implementation of agreements on rights of Hungarian minority – Sybiha
summary: Ukraine is ready to accelerate the implementation of agreements on ensuring the linguistic, cultural and educational rights of the Hungarian national minority, as the necessary legal framework is already in place.

title: Russians strike community in Zhytomyr region again, injury toll rises to nine
summary: Russian forces have launched a second attack on civilian infrastructure in the Malyn community, Zhytomyr region, killing one person and injuring nine others.

title: Khmara, Stoltenberg discuss strengthening Ukraine's air defenses and supporting defense industry
summary: Ukraine's Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara met with Norwegian Finance Minister Jens Stoltenberg during an official visit to Oslo to discuss strengthening Ukraine's air defenses and supporting the country’s defense industry.

title: Russia drops 500-kg FAB-500 bomb on Sloviansk
summary: Russian forces have dropped a 500-kilogram FAB-500 glide bomb on central Sloviansk in the Donetsk region, killing one person and injuring another.

title: Ukraine ready for next POW exchange, Coordination Headquarters secretary says
summary: Dmytro Usov, secretary of Ukraine’s Coordination Headquarters for the Treatment of Prisoners of War, visited Russian POWs at a detention camp.

title: Parliament approves Ukraine’s accession to Steering Committee of Special Tribunal on Russian Aggression
summary: The Verkhovna Rada has ratified the Enlarged Partial Agreement on the Steering Committee of the Special Tribunal for the Crime of Aggression against Ukraine, a key step toward securing the tribunal’s funding and enabling it to begin operations.

title: HUR deep-strike destroys Russia’s unique aerospace reconnaissance system
summary: Ukraine’s Defense Intelligence (HUR) has destroyed a Russian aerospace reconnaissance and information system in a deep-strike operation.

title: Russian attack on industrial facility and parking lot in Zhytomyr Region kills one, injures five
summary: One person was killed and five others injured in a Russian attack on the Malyn community in Zhytomyr region.

title: Ukrainian soldier rescued a dog during the Kursk Operation. Now she’s his constant companion
summary: Vladyslav Budivskyi, a platoon commander in the unmanned systems unit of the 199th Air Assault Forces Training Center, rescued an exhausted German-Australian Shepherd in Sudzha during the Kursk operation. The dog, whom he named Princess, now goes everywhere with him.

title: Naftogaz facility in Poltava Region halts operations after Russian attack
summary: Russian forces have struck a Naftogaz Group facility in Ukraine’s Poltava region, forcing it to suspend operations.

title: Ukraine’s Defense Forces strike Savasleyka airfield, destroy five aircraft used in attacks on Ukraine
summary: Ukraine’s Defense Forces have struck the Russian Savasleyka airfield, which hosts MiG-31K aircraft capable of carrying Kinzhal missiles.

title: Ukrainian forces strike two Russian oil refineries
summary: Ukrainian Defense Forces, in coordination with the “Black Spark” resistance movement, struck two oil refineries in Russia’s Samara region, Ukraine’s General Staff has said.

title: Trump says he has set no deadline for Ukraine-Russia peace deal
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump said he had set no deadline for reaching a peace deal between Ukraine and Russia, saying he hoped the war would end as soon as possible.

title: Latvian PM promises good news on Ukrainian grain exports
summary: “Good news” on the transit and export of Ukrainian grain through Latvia is expected soon.

title: Ukraine’s parliament passes law to legalize cryptocurrency
summary: Ukrainian parliament, the Verkhovna Rada, has passed legislation legalizing the cryptocurrency market and establishing a tax framework for virtual asset transactions.

title: Berehove could become a symbol of Ukraine-Hungary cooperation – Mayor
summary: Berehove Mayor Zoltán Babják called the Ukrainian-Hungarian leaders’ meeting in the city a historic event for the community and an opportunity to attract investment.

title: New €45 billion support instrument to cover two-thirds of Ukraine’s 2027 Needs – von der Leyen
summary: The European Union will continue to provide comprehensive support to Ukraine, from funding hospitals and schools to supplying drones and interceptors. It has proposed a new €45 billion financing mechanism to support Ukraine in 2027.

title: One person killed, four injured as Russian forces attack enterprise in Zhytomyr region
summary: One person was killed and four others injured in a Russian attack on the Malyn community in the Zhytomyr region.

title: Zaporizhzhia NPP loses external power supply after Russian attack
summary: The Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant lost its external power supply following a Russian attack and is currently operating on diesel generators.

title: Estonia’s FM arrives in Kyiv
summary: Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna has arrived in Kyiv on an official visit.

title: Results of Zelensky-Magyar meeting expected in January-February, ambassador says
summary: Ukraine’s Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary to Hungary, Fedir Shandor, said that the results of the meeting between President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky and Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar would become clear in January-February.

title: SSU foils assassination attempt on commander of Special Operations Forces unit
summary: The SSU military counterintelligence department in the Kharkiv region, with the assistance of the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and the command of the Ukrainian Special Operations Forces, foiled a contract killing plot targeting the commander of one of the Defense Forces' largest classified units.

title: Russia has around 100 troops inside Kupiansk, with no sign of encirclement – Tregubov
summary: The number of Russian troops who have managed to infiltrate Kupiansk remains at around 100.

title: Injury toll in Russian attack on Kyiv rises to three
summary: The number of people injured after a Russian drone struck the courtyard of an apartment building in Kyiv’s Shevchenkivskyi district in the evening of November 24 has risen to three.

title: Russian forces strike Zaporizhzhia in morning attack, injuries, damage reported
summary: Three people were injured in a Russian attack on the Shevchenkivskyi district of Zaporizhzhia on Wednesday morning, November 25.

title: Russian drone attack on Volyn region injures five, fire at enterprise extinguished
summary: Five people were injured in a Russian attack in the Kovel district of the Volyn region in the evening of November 24.

title: Two Rosneft oil refineries in Russia’s Samara region on fire following drone attack – media
summary: A fire broke out at an oil refinery in the city of Syzran, Samara region, Russia, on Wednesday amid a drone attack.

title: Russian drones attack civilian and energy infrastructure in Zhytomyr region, one person injured
summary: Russian drones targeted civilian and energy infrastructure in the Zhytomyr region, injuring one person.

title: Air defenses down 88 of 112 Russian drones targeting Ukraine overnight
summary: Russian forces attacked Ukraine with 112 attack drones overnight on the night of November 24-25.

title: War update: Over 200 clashes on front lines over past day, Pokrovsk axis hottest
summary: As many as 203 combat engagements between the Ukrainian Defense Forces and Russian invading forces were recorded along the front line on November 24, with the highest number of Russian attacks on the Pokrovsk axis.
